title: Ramsey Obstructions to Disambiguation
summary: A partial matrix has entries in $\{0,1,\star\}$, and a disambiguation replaces each $\star$ by $0$ or $1$. We construct partial matrices whose fully specified submatrices satisfy strong restrictions, yet every disambiguation contains every binary matrix of a prescribed size. Our first result answers a question of Alon, Hanneke, Holzman and Moran on the disambiguation of linear classifiers with margin.
